lines.text: We're just vibing to music today.

data.define: Relaxing and enjoying the mood or music.

example.text: We're just vibing to music today.

misuse.text: Don't say 'vibing' about a vibrating phone.
misuse.why: It means enjoying a relaxed mood.

publish.title: What does "vibing" mean?
publish.value: Vibing = Enjoying the moment. Example: "We're just vibing to music today." (casual English).
